title: Null control: Oman GKG share -> SPY 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control: GDELT Oman GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads SPY log returns by 5 days (+); if SPY shows a similar edge the ZW=F result is a generic risk-on effect, not a grain-freight channel; trade long SPY 5d [gdelt.gkg.oman_share -> finance.SPY.log_return] (parent: R2-0042)
message: Null control FAILS to clear ZW=F: same Oman-share rule on SPY gives hit 77% (22 trades), excess +0.55%/trade, OOS hit 83% (6 trades); correlation itself is noise (r=0.06, validity 0). Parent ZW=F edge is consistent with generic risk-on beta, not a grain-freight channel.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.oman_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long SPY next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 8 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Null control 2: GDELT Oman GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads corn ZC=F log returns by 5 days (+); if corn (no Gulf freight link) also shows the SPY-sized edge, the ZW=F wheat result is a broad commodity/risk-on beta, not a grain-freight channel; trade long ZC=F 5d [gdelt.gkg.oman_share -> finance.ZC=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0141)
